capabilities: Display newest articles from RSS feeds with pictures in a styled note
Track read and unread articles and save pieces to a read-later list
Clip articles into the vault using Obsidian Web Clipper templates
Add custom magazines and filter feed articles by headline or URL
extras: Installed via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases rather than the community plugin listing. Articles and read state are kept in the plugin's data.json, which the README advises ignoring if the vault is under git. Paywalled articles may clip only their opening paragraphs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to follow news feeds or read magazine articles inside the vault; you must leave the app to keep up with publications.

relations.evidence: The scissors save an article as a note in your vault, using your Obsidian Web Clipper templates

summary: RSS feed reader that turns one note into a magazine-style front page of latest articles from the magazines you follow, kept up to date.
